Attach the /plan and /implement carriers to a repository the construct did not write, hidden through .git/info/exclude (alias: jack-in) (construct attach v<version>)

USAGE construct attach [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

                       --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                                                                                                            
                           --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)                                                                                        
                          --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)                                                                                                     
               --harness=<harness>    The harness command the ladder verifies with; nothing is assumed                                                                         
  --requiredCheck=<required_check>    The name of the CI check run the bus waits for; recorded in .construct/attach.json                                                       
         --ai=<claude|cursor|both>    AI target: claude (cursor and both are refused)                                                                                          
                   --lanes=<lanes>    How many parallel lanes the bus runs, recorded in .construct/attach.json                                                                 
                   --serve=<serve>    The command that brings the server up for a browser witness; needs --serveUrl                                                            
            --serveUrl=<serve_url>    The URL that answers once the server is up; needs --serve                                                                                
                         -y, --yes    Non-interactive: skip the confirmation; needs --harness (Default: false)                                                                 
                           --entry    Print the entry protocol the agent follows to propose one harness; reads and writes nothing (Default: false)                             
                         --upgrade    Rewrite the carriers to this version and add the browser lab exclusion to the local settings; data, handoff and bus stay (Default: false)
